description: Electric truck charging and Tesla Megachargers: "Tesla Megacharger locations", "truck charging near Waco, TX", "Megachargers in Texas", "MCS chargers on my drive from Atlanta to Savannah", "where is the next Megacharger opening?". Tesla's public Megacharger sites (for Tesla Semi) and other networks' heavy-duty truck sites, including megawatt (MCS, SAE J3271) sites from NREL. Send place (or lat and lng) for the nearest sites, sorted by distance, nearest first; state for one state's sites; or from and to (with optional via) for sites along a drive, sorted by miles from the start. With none of these, every site is listed, open ones first. Filter by status (open, construction, permit, announced or not_open) and kind (megacharger, other_networks or mcs). Each site comes with its status, stalls and power per stall where published, connector, host, access, address (the town only where the street address isn't published yet), last-verified date, every source with its link and date, and its ChargingNear.me page link (url). A site is Open only when Tesla or its host confirms it; a permit filing doesn't make it Open.

corridor_miles.description: With from and to: how far from the route a site may be, in miles (default 10, max 25)

from.description: For sites along a drive: where it starts, a U.S. city or address ("Atlanta, GA"), or "lat,lng"

kind.description: megacharger: Tesla Megachargers; other_networks: other networks' heavy-duty truck sites; mcs: sites with MCS (SAE J3271) plugs; all (the default)

lat.description: Latitude (with lng), if you have coordinates instead of a place

place.description: A U.S. city, address, ZIP code or truck stop, e.g. "Waco, TX", for the nearest sites. Use instead of lat and lng.

radius.description: With place or lat and lng: only sites within this many miles (max 3000; by default the nearest sites at any distance)

state.description: Only one state's sites: a two-letter code (TX) or name (Texas)

status.description: open; construction (under construction); permit (permit filed); announced; not_open (every site not open yet); any (the default)

to.description: Where the drive ends, like from ("Savannah, GA")

via.description: Stops in between, in driving order, like from (optional)

name: find_truck_charging
title: Truck charging and Tesla Megachargers
